settings.intro_highlight: The Dainolite Magnifier LED delivers professional-grade optical clarity and cool-to-the-touch illumination, engineered specifically to support estheticians and med-spa specialists during detailed skin examinations.
settings.custom_description: The Dainolite Magnifier Lamp is built in accordance with Equipro's tradition of quality North American manufacturing. Extensively tested to withstand the rigors of high-volume aesthetic environments, it features powerful LED lighting, a hygienic dust and sun protector, and a flexible reach to the center of the lens. Choose between 3.5 diopters (3D) and 5 diopters (5D) configurations to match your precise clinical needs.
settings.subtitle: Professional Optical Clarity & Reliable Durability
settings.secondary_description: Designed for multi-year commercial service, the Dainolite magnifier combines robust build quality with energy-efficient LED technology. Routine care with optical lens cloths preserves surface integrity and guarantees uncompromised visual precision across everyday salon routines.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Securely attach the magnifier stem to your compatible Equipro floor base, rolling cart, or wall mounting bracket.
Plug the power cord into a grounded 110V outlet and activate the power switch for instant-start LED illumination.
Flip open the integrated hygienic dust and sun protector to expose the precision optical glass.
Adjust the balanced articulated arm to position the lens smoothly over the treatment zone at the preferred focal distance.
Close the protective dust cover immediately following the procedure to safeguard the lens surface.
Never leave the magnifying lens uncovered near direct sunlight windows, as the glass can concentrate rays and create a severe fire hazard.
Do not force the articulated arm beyond its maximum designed extension threshold to prevent internal tension strain.
Electrical repairs and internal component servicing must be handled by certified technicians to maintain compliance.

settings.question: What diopter options are available for this lamp?
settings.answer: It is available in 3.5 Diopters (3D) and 5 Diopters (5D) configurations selectable via product variants.

settings.question: Does the lamp include a protective cover?
settings.answer: Yes, it features an integrated hygienic dust and sun protector shield built into the lamp head.

settings.question: What is the arm reach distance?
settings.answer: The balanced articulated arm offers an extended reach of up to 43 to 49 inches to the center of the lens.

settings.question: Are mounting accessories included with purchase?
settings.answer: Mounting stems are standard, but specific desk bases, wall brackets, or rolling cart mounts are sold separately depending on salon layout requirements.

settings.question: What type of warranty coverage is provided?
settings.answer: The Dainolite Magnifier is protected by a 1-year limited manufacturer warranty covering parts and labor.
